context.transcript:
And now for the Radio 10 Community Bulletin Board.
The Riverdale Garden Club has announced that club members will be hosting the annual garden tour on Saturday and Sunday, May 7th and 8th.
The event features tours of several local gardens which have been designed and planted by club members.
Tickets are available for $10 each on the club's website, www.riverdalegardenclub.com.
Money raised from the sale of tickets will be used to repair the fountain in Riverdale Park.
context.transcript_translation:
现在是Radio 10社区公告板时间。
Riverdale Garden Club宣布，俱乐部成员将于5月7日和8日举办一年一度的园艺之旅。
活动包括参观几座由俱乐部成员设计和种植的当地花园。
门票可在俱乐部的网站www.riverdalegardenclub.com购买，每张10美元。
出售门票所筹集的资金将用于修复Riverdale公园里的喷泉。
